title: Map component data
description: Trip map. Places are place_<id> keys, one entry each: add one with key place_* and an id is minted (example place_* = {"title":"Wieliczka","latitude":50.0647,"longitude":20.0555,"order":1}). order sets the sequence (lower first, ties by id; append with the highest order + 1). Consecutive places are joined by legs: leg_<fromId>__<toId> (two underscores) holds how to travel between them (example leg_a__b = {"mode":"train","line":"IC 3510","departure":"08:15","arrival":"09:40"}). A pair with no leg uses the previous leg's mode; the first leg is car. To add a leg to a place you just added, first add the place, read its id from the keys, then write the leg in a second call. A leg whose pair is no longer consecutive is ignored. To delete a place write '' to place_<id> and to every leg_ key naming it. Times: place date/time are local "be here at" values; leg departure/arrival are HH:MM local without a date, the leg's day is the date of its from-place, and an arrival earlier than the departure means the next day. markers is the legacy list, read-only: readers still show it, and a place_<id> with the same id replaces that marker. Agents cannot upload files: copy attachmentIds back unchanged when editing an entry, never add ids. Members may write places and legs only while allowAddMarkerInUsage is true.

centerLatitude.description: Latitude of the map centre in degrees. Example: 52.2297.

centerLongitude.description: Longitude of the map centre in degrees. Example: 21.0122.

zoom.description: Zoom level of the map. Higher is closer. Default 13.

markers.description: Deprecated legacy v1 pins, read-only and never written. Readers show them under place_ keys of the same id. Write places as place_ keys instead.

allowAddMarkerInUsage.description: When true, members may add and edit places and legs in the app and through MCP. Owner and admin always may. Default false.

routeMarkerIds.description: Ids of the places the route passes through, in order. Superseded by place order and legs. Example: ["a","b"].

routeStrokeWidth.description: Thickness of the route line in pixels. Default 3.

showRouteDistance.description: true shows the route length. Default true.

trackUserLocation.description: true shows the viewer's own location on the map. Default true.

useUserLocationInRoute.description: true includes the viewer's own location in the route. Applies only when routeEnabled is true. Default false.

_title.description: Panel title shown above the component. '' clears it. Example: "Groceries".

_sectionBreak.description: true starts a new visual section, with a bigger gap above and a stronger separator.

_width.description: Preferred width in logical pixels. Default 600, minimum 300.

_spaceAbove.description: Legacy spacing above in pixels, no longer written. When _sectionBreak is absent, a value of 16 or more reads as a section break.

_spaceBelow.description: Legacy spacing below in pixels, no longer written.

^place_[^_]+$.description: One place, per $defs/place; '' deletes it (also tombstone every leg_ key that names it). The key carries the id, which has no underscore. Example: place_0198a0f2 = {"title":"Wieliczka","latitude":50.0647,"longitude":20.0555,"order":1,"date":"2026-07-04","time":"10:00"}. Members may write this key only while allowAddMarkerInUsage is true; owner and admin always may.

^leg_[^_]+__[^_]+$.description: How to travel from place <fromId> to the next place <toId>, per $defs/leg; '' deletes it. The key is leg_<fromId>__<toId> with two underscores. Example: leg_a__b = {"mode":"train","line":"IC 3510","departure":"08:15","arrival":"09:40"}. departure and arrival are HH:MM local without a date; the leg's day is the date of the from-place; an arrival earlier than departure means the next day. Members may write this key only while allowAddMarkerInUsage is true; owner and admin always may.

^_.description: Other layout and UI keys starting with _. Any value.

id.description: Marker id, unique in the map.

type.description: Marker role: standard, start, waypoint or destination.

createdBy.description: Public key of the member who created the marker, or ''.

createdAtMs.description: Creation time in epoch milliseconds. 0 means unset.

displayName.description: Legacy. Display name of the user.

lastUpdated.description: Legacy. ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.

place.description: One place of the trip. Example: {"title":"Wieliczka","latitude":50.0647,"longitude":20.0555,"order":1,"date":"2026-07-04","time":"10:00"}.

v.description: Entry version. Written by the app; agents may omit it.

description.description: Longer text for the place. Example: "Salt mine tour, book tickets."

type.description: Marker role: standard, start, waypoint or destination.

createdBy.description: Public key of the member who created the marker, or ''.

createdAtMs.description: Creation time in epoch milliseconds. 0 means unset.

date.description: Local date to be here, YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone. null or absent means unset. Example: "2026-07-04".

time.description: Local time to be here at, HH:MM 24-hour, no time zone, on the place's date. null or absent means unset. Example: "10:00".

remindBefore.description: Minutes before date and time at which all members get a reminder. Needs date and time. null or absent means no reminder. Example: 60.

attachmentIds.description: Ids of attached files. Agents cannot upload files: copy back unchanged, never add ids.

order.description: Position in the trip, lower first, ties broken by id. Append with the highest order + 1. Example: 2.

leg.description: How to travel from a place to the next one, stored under leg_<fromId>__<toId>. departure and arrival are HH:MM local without a date; the leg's day is the date of the from-place; an arrival earlier than departure means the next day. Example: {"mode":"train","line":"IC 3510","departure":"08:15","arrival":"09:40"}.

v.description: Entry version. Written by the app; agents may omit it.

mode.description: Means of travel: car, bike, foot, train or bus. Example: "train".

line.description: Line, route or flight name. null or absent means unset. Example: "IC 3510".

departure.description: Departure time, HH:MM local without a date; the day is the date of the from-place. null or absent means unset. Example: "08:15".

arrival.description: Arrival time, HH:MM local without a date; earlier than departure means the next day. null or absent means unset. Example: "09:40".

description.description: Longer text for the leg. Example: "Platform 2, seat reserved."

attachmentIds.description: Ids of attached files such as tickets. Agents cannot upload files: copy back unchanged, never add ids.
